title: A swimmer on which branch?
hook: The oceans held many kinds of reptile.

knows: Related groups can branch from an earlier common ancestor.
doesNotKnow: Locate plesiosaurs outside Dinosauria on a simplified tree.

misconception: Every prehistoric marine reptile was a dinosaur.
objective: Locate plesiosaurs outside Dinosauria on a simplified tree.

claims.text: The oceans held many kinds of reptile. In this simplified tree, are plesiosaurs members of the dinosaur branch? The highlighted dinosaur branch does not include plesiosaurs. Plesiosaurs were marine reptiles, but sharing an ancient reptile ancestor or an ocean with another animal does not make them dinosaurs.
